wiktionary.gloss: A phrase used to protest against "black lives matter" (rally call, political and social movement) mostly by white people, to protect their traditional white prerogatives and privileges.

examples: Please wipe down the kitchen appliances.
The fridge door is grimy. Please wipe it down with some spray cleaner.
wiktionary.gloss: To clean the exterior surface of an object, from top to bottom, typically by hand using a damp dishcloth or other cleaning cloth.
The mongoose Cynictis penicillata.
